name: system-events
description: Shared catalogue of events a story's systems/*.json can opt into via a system's "events" block, each with a "frequency" whose meaning depends on the event's "kind": "special_asteroid" (rich_ore_vein) rolls per AsteroidField chunk as the player travels; "pirate_ambush" (lone_pirate) rolls once per system entry and, on a hit, spawns a hostile AI ship a short distance from the player with a tribute-or-fight hail (see game/screens/space_screen/pirates.py); "derelict_ship" rolls once per system entry and periodically thereafter (same idiom as pirate_ambush) and, on a hit, spawns a static, unpiloted wreck safely off-screen/off-minimap for the player to discover and board (see game/screens/space_screen/derelicts.py, game/world/derelict_ship.py). This module only owns the derelict_ship *mechanism* - it does not itself define any concrete derelict types (loot table, payout range, pirate ship+pilot for a trap all reference story-specific ids). A story defines its own named derelict types in its own story-scoped events.json (merged over this file exactly like ship_outfits.json/asteroid_types.json - see CONFIG_MODULES.md and mining_101/events.json's adrift_hauler/stranded_skiff/suspect_wreck for a worked example), and a system's systems/*.json "events" array references those types by id with its own frequency/interval, the same lightweight reference-by-id idiom every other event kind already uses. Other kinds (scannable anomalies, wormholes) are meant to land in this same catalogue later, each with its own spawn path (see setup.py's _build_system_events / _build_pirate_ambush_configs / _build_derelict_configs) without changing the config shape.
